title: Yellow Browned Argentinian Shrimp Empanadas
description: A traditional Argentinian dish featuring shrimp and spices in a crispy empanada, cooked to a golden brown in a tandoor clay pot. This recipe combines the flavors of the Mediterranean with the heartiness of Argentinian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the shrimp paste, flour, and spices.
Add the butter and eggs to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a tablespoon of shrimp paste in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil and place them in the preheated tandoor clay pot.
Cook the empanadas for 20 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
Remove the empanadas from the pot and let them cool for 5 minutes before serving.
